verdict.rationale: Docs describe how errors are automatically grouped (raygun-docs-7) and how to resolve/ignore errors (raygun-docs-10, raygun-docs-11), but there is no mention of a merge-issues or split-groups feature to manually correct fingerprinting errors. Missing for 10: any documented merge/combine error groups action, any documented split/un-merge action, UI or API evidence of manual grouping correction.
